india_trends.title: Piyush Goyal set to embark on 7-day US visit from September 29: G20 meet, trade talks with America on agenda
india_trends.summary: Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal begins a week-long US visit on September 29. His discussions aim to strengthen India-US trade ties amid ongoing talks on the Bilateral Trade Agreement.

india_trends.title: India-UAE target $200bn bilateral trade by 2032; commit to local currencies, payments, digital initiatives — Check here
india_trends.summary: India and UAE today agreed on timely implementation of initiatives relating to settlement of trade in local currencies, integration of payment and messaging systems, and central-bank digital currencies.&nbsp;

india_trends.title: RBI steps up bond sales to ₹1 trillion, first time in a decade: Explained
india_trends.summary: The RBI's bond sell-off of 1 trillion rupees signals tighter monetary policy, leading to expectations of a yield curve flattening. With reduced supply of debt, market participants foresee further open-market operations and increased borrowing rates.

india_trends.title: Why can’t India boost exports to China? Sitharaman flags lack of market access, 'It goes to Vietnam, then China’
india_trends.summary: FM Sitharaman stated that India lacks sufficient access to the Chinese market, highlighting how many exports to China are routed through Vietnam. She emphasized the gap in trade figures and criticized China's denial of direct market access for Indian goods like buffalo meat and pharmaceuticals.

india_trends.title: Industrial production up 8% YoY in August amid strong support from manufacturing and electricity, shows govt data
india_trends.summary: India's industrial output increased by 8% in August 2026 compared to 7.4% in the previous month, mainly due to a good show by the manufacturing sector, the latest government data released today showed.

india_trends.title: RBI to raise interest rates to 5.50% in October as inflation broadens, shows poll
india_trends.summary: RBI is expected to raise interest rates by 25 bps to 5.50% in October, the first increase since 2023, with one more hike likely in December, a majority of economists polled by Reuters said, as inflation picks up.

india_trends.title: How gold sector is gearing up $100 bn export target as India eyes massive expansion in $55 bn FTA jewellery market
india_trends.summary: Sachin Jain, Regional CEO, India, World Gold Council, said that over the next five to seven years, nearly 20 percent to 25 percent of India’s gold consumption could come from domestic mines, while jewellery exports are targeted at $100 billion.
